title: N -W F P Maintenance of Public Order Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Maintenance of Public Order Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XX OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE
MAINTENANCE OF
PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XX OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 11th June, 2002]
No. Legis. 1(4)/95/4519/4693,
dated 11-6-2002.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--- (1) This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Maintenance of Public Order (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Maintenance of Public Order Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of W.P. Ordinance No. XXXI of 1960

ORDINANCE XX OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE
MAINTENANCE OF
PUBLIC ORDER (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XX OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the West Pakistan Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 11th June, 2002]
No. Legis. 1(4)/95/4519/4693,
dated 11-6-2002.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 3 of
W.P. Ordinance No. XXXI of 1960. In the West Pakistan Maintenance of Public
Order Ordinance, 1960 (W.P. Ordinance XXXI of 1960), hereinafter referred to as
the said Ordinance, in section 3,--
(a) in
subsection (2), for the words "a Zilla Nazim or any other", the word
":my" shall be substituted, and after the word Government occurring
for the first time, a comma shall be inserted;
(b) in
subsection (8), for the words "a Zilla Nazim", the words. commas,
brackets and figure "any servant of Government referred to in subsection
(2)", and for the words "the Zilla Nazim", the words "such
servant of Government" shall respectively be substituted; and
(c) in
subsection (10), for the words "The Zilla Nazim", the word
"Government" shall be substituted and between the words "if
in" and the word "his", the words "its or" shall be
inserted.

No. Legis. 1(4)/95/4519/4693,
dated 11-6-2002.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
3. Amendment of section 5 of
W.P. Ordinance No. XXXI of 1960.- In the said Ordinance, in section 5,--
(a) m subsection
(1), for the words "the Zilla Nazim", the words, commas brackets and
figures "any servant of Government, referred to in subsection (2) of
section 3," shall be substituted;
(b) in
subsection (2) for the words "the Zilla Nazim", the words, brackets
and figure "any servant of Government, referred to in subsection
(1)," shall be substituted:
(c) in
subsection (3) for the words "the Zilla Nazim", words "any such
servant" shall be substituted; and
(d) In
subsection (4) for the words "the Zilla Nazim", wherever occurring,
the words commas, brackets and figure "any servant of Government, referred
to in subsection (1)." Shall be substituted.
